mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with higher S&P 500 forward 5-day returns, as lower rates reduce the discount rate applied to equity valuations and stimulate economic activity.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS predicting 5-day returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) from the previous month signals a weakening in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS decline from the previous month, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) in at least 3 out of 5 consecutive 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0%, it signals a weakening labor market that prompts monetary policy accommodation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE > 5.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of monthly payroll employment growth (PAYEMS) is associated with stronger economic activity and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: Rank IC for PAYEMS predicting 20-day returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below the 2017 base index (100) signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, reducing corporate profits and leading to negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 100 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: When both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS increase from the previous month, the 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) in at least 3 out of 5 consecutive 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 2000 thousand units, it signals a contraction in the housing sector that prompts monetary policy easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when HOUST < 2000 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
